S112 MIGRATION: detection change only, doctrine/claim/source_quote/page/verified unchanged. Antecedent moved from the TERMINATION landmark (Position -> target) to the typed stopped_by verb token (via free-verb CONTACTS + contact_mapper). Reason: a bare TERMINATION -> Line of Heart/Head cannot distinguish an abrupt HALT (this rule's doctrine) from a JOIN-AND-CONTINUE (FT_016's opposite, good-omen doctrine) at the same endpoint -- the old antecedent could false-positive the 'success ruined' claim on a hand whose fate line actually ascends to Jupiter. Requiring an explicit stopped_by report fires only on a confirmed halt; when only a landmark is available the rule now stays silent (honest-silence over confident-wrong). LOWER-CONFIDENCE: live stopped_by-verb emission is untested (no test hand halts the fate line at head/heart) -- fixture-only until such a hand is sourced; if a future real halt-hand shows vision emits a landmark but NOT the verb, revisit whether a second-call or compound antecedent is needed.

schema_flags: OCR ARTIFACT: source line reads 'V hen' (OCR misread of 'When') and 'failm*e' (OCR misread of 'failure') -- preserved verbatim per chunk_exact convention, not corrected.

ANTECEDENT SIMPLIFICATION: source names two qualities, 'broken and irregular'. Authored as a single Continuity=broken antecedent only -- ANDing a second Continuity=irregular antecedent on the SAME feature/attribute would create a self-contradictory, permanently-unfireable rule (an attribute can hold only one observed value; _antecedent_fires does plain equality per antecedent). schema_flags: RE-POINTED (Step 3 of 3): was Continuity=broken (misfortune/loss claim, duplicating FT_011's antecedent); now Continuity=broken_overlapping, reachability re-asserted against registry v1.5.0 -- Continuity is unbound (flat pool) and legal for Line of Fate; 'broken_overlapping' confirmed present in the flat value pool. source_quote widened to the FULL line-1113 sentence (both the general 'misfortune and loss' clause and the contrasting 'but if the second portion ... begin before the other leaves off' clause) because the overlap-specific claim only makes sense as a contrast against the general-break clause it overrides -- not extracted as an isolated fragment.

RESOLVED DESIGN POINT (Sulabh's ruling): FT_011 (Continuity=broken) and FT_012 (Continuity=broken_overlapping) are mutually exclusive values of the SAME single-valued attribute -- a fate line's Continuity observation can equal only one of them at a time, so they can never both fire on one hand. No precedence/defeat rule is needed between them; base-vs-specific is handled entirely by value granularity, not by a subset-demotion mechanism.
